definition: A lineage edge whose descendant flourishes more than twenty-five years before the ancestor it is said to descend from. The record keeps the edge and the tree flags it; it is not silently redrawn.
basis: docs/workbench.md, the family tree since Phase 17: an edge "that breaks the chronology: a descendant that flourishes well before the ancestor it is said to descend" from, flagged by "the validator's own warning, which the build has printed and no page has shown". build/validate.py states the rule: "a node should not predate an ancestor it descends from".
